authorization.user: Finish base actions and continue integration

coverage.scope: non-skill base actions; user-requested two-hand horizontal/horizontal/rising combo

state_mapping.GUARD: guard_start / guard / parry or recoil / guard_end

coverage.turn: visual turn only; facing/gameplay state stays authoritative; interrupted immediately by attacks

reuse.run_stop: source guard pivot pose explicitly reused

coverage.height_policy: CharacterBody physics height only; source height_px is review reference and never added in game
coverage.root_policy: Existing gameplay root motion only; trimmed layer offsets never move the actor
